description:
Plan a whole product film from a one-line brief. Returns the beats, one video component per beat with alternatives, the frame budget, one install command for every component, and a src/Film.tsx skeleton on a TransitionSeries that renders with the components' demo copy.

It infers the archetype from the brief: product demo, product launch, changelog, onboarding, App Store preview or launch-day film. Pass archetype, length (bumper, short, standard, long) or format (landscape, vertical, square) to override.

Use it before writing a Remotion composition. Then load each component with get-motion-guide({ component }) and replace the demo copy with the product's own.

archetype.description: Omit to infer it from the brief.

brief.description: One line: what the film is about and who it is for.

context.description: Optional. One sentence on WHY you are calling this and what the user asked for (e.g. 'adding nav icons for the fintech dashboard'). Used only for usage analytics; does not change the result.

length.description: bumper about 5s, short about 18s, standard about 40s, long 60s. Omit for the archetype's default.

name: plan-video
title: Plan a Video
